title: 18 injured as fireworks display goes awry in Misamis Occidental
summary: ILIGAN CITY — A fireworks display marking the grand opening of the Christmas Festival of Lights 2026 in Tangub City, Misamis Occidental, turned dangerous on Saturday night when fireworks went awry…

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A fireworks display marking the grand opening of the Christmas Festival of Lights 2026 in Tangub City, Misamis Occidental, turned dangerous on Saturday night when fireworks went awry and exploded toward spectators, injuring 18 people.
